candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in IT & AI. You ask for hands-on experience with LLM APIs such as Anthropic's, Python with REST and JSON, and dashboards for Finance and HR: I built an application on the Claude API, and as a Business Analyst I built an employee expense reimbursement dashboard.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea, supporting dashboards for HR, finance, supply chain and procurement.

achievements.impact: I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag) with the Claude API, a FastAPI REST API and a Streamlit UI; it answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly
I built an employee expense reimbursement dashboard in SAP Analytics Cloud and supported around 30 dashboards across HR, finance and procurement
I collected requirements from business users, handled their daily queries and documented every dashboard I built

letter.problems_section: I would map processes with Finance, HR and Procurement, build AI-supported tools and dashboards for them, test new AI tools and train colleagues to use what we build. I have not used low-code workflow tools or MCP yet, and I am keen to learn them in practice.
letter.closing: I can come to Freiburg for onboarding and then work remotely from Ilmenau for up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
